title: Common point-blowup resolution of regular proper surfaces
statement: Let $S$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Let $T_1,T_2$ be integral schemes [def-pc-integral-scheme], proper over $S$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], regular [def-weil-regular-scheme] and of dimension two [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Given an $S$-isomorphism between dense open subschemes of $T_1$ and $T_2$ [def-weil-open-immersion], there is a regular integral $S$-scheme $W$ and morphisms $q_i:W\to T_i$ inducing the given birational identification, each a finite composition of blowups of reduced closed points [def-nagata-global-blowup].

source.place: Tag 0C5S (lemma-birational-regular-surfaces); the specified identification is the rational map used in its proof.

proof.text: Write the given identification as $\alpha:U_1\xrightarrow{\sim}U_2$, with both $U_i$ dense, and put $f:U_1\to T_2$ equal to $\alpha$ followed by the open immersion. Each $T_i$ is Noetherian: its proper structural morphism is of finite type, and a scheme of finite type over the Noetherian scheme $S$ is Noetherian. Also $T_2\to S$ is separated by the definition of properness.

Apply elimination of indeterminacy to $X=T_1$, $Y=T_2$, the dense open $U_1$ and the $S$-map $f$. It gives a tower of point blowups $p:W=X_n\to T_1$ and an $S$-map $g:W\to T_2$ agreeing with $f$ over $U_1$. Its statement supplies that $W$ is integral, regular, Noetherian and of dimension $2$, that $p$ is proper, and that $p^{-1}(U_1)\to U_1$ is an isomorphism. In particular this nonempty open is dense in the integral scheme $W$.

The structure map $W\to S$ is proper, being the composite of $p$ with the proper map $T_1\to S$. Since $T_2\to S$ is separated and $g$ is an $S$-map, properness over a separated target gives that $g$ is proper. On the dense open $p^{-1}(U_1)$ the map $g$ is exactly $\alpha\circ p$, an isomorphism onto the dense open $U_2$. Thus $g$ is birational in the explicit dense-open sense required by the factorization theorem.

source.place: Tag 0C5S, properness and birationality of the extended morphism.

proof.text: Apply proper birational surface factorization to $g:W\to T_2$: both schemes are integral regular Noetherian of dimension $2$, and the preceding step supplies properness and the dense-open isomorphism. Hence $g$ is a finite composition of blowups at reduced closed points. Set $q_1=p$ and $q_2=g$. The first has its point-blowup tower from Step 2 and the second from this factorization. Equip the second tower with the structural maps obtained by composing to $T_2\to S$; its maps and the identification of its top with $W$ are then over $S$. The equality $q_2|_{q_1^{-1}(U_1)}=\alpha\circ q_1|_{q_1^{-1}(U_1)}$ from Step 2 preserves precisely the specified birational identification. This proves every clause, including the case of a tower of length zero.
